You command two tank squads (Return-Fire orders) of three medium tanks each, staging north and south along the west edge — exact cells vary by seed. The mid-map enemy cluster at (22,20) mixes four riflemen, two rocket soldiers, and one enemy medium tank, all on Defend orders. Score 6 kills, bring at least 4 tanks into the (22,20) disc (radius 8), and lose no more than 2 tanks, within 4500 ticks.
